text:
sam: Quick thought — we should support 'deferred host anchors' for routes that only apply when no higher-specificity host matches. Idea: host anchors can be marked `defer:true` so they don't compete in the first pass. This avoids spurious shadowing of customer host aliases. Thoughts?

maria: cc @sam, sounds useful. How would `defer:true` interact with header-anchoring? If header anchor matches, do we still pick header?

ashton: I lean toward a two-pass matcher instead of a boolean that changes semantics everywhere. First pass: non-deferred anchors. Second pass: deferred anchors. Simpler to reason about for rollouts.

lee: Two-pass seems intuitive. Implementation caveat: potential perf impact if a large proportion is marked deferred. But if we default defer=false and only mark a few, should be fine.

sam: Example DSL sketch: `host { pattern: "*.example", anchor: "host", defer: true }` or annotate `anchors: [{type: host, defer: true, score: 10}]`. The `defer` flag explicitly removes it from primary index.

maria: We should also think about console UX — a route marked deferred should show a clear badge and an "explain why not matched" trace. We had a case where deferred behavior confused support.

ashton: One more thought: instead of boolean, what about an explicit phase enum `phase: primary|fallback`? That maps directly to the two-pass idea and lets us extend phases later.

lee: phase enum is nicer. Also: tiebreakers between header and host anchors still need clarity. Proposal: matching order = phase -> anchor_type precedence (header > host > service) -> score -> deterministic hash.

sam: I like that ordering. header outranks host unless header is in fallback phase.

maria: Also add telemetry: emit `match.reason` with phase+anchor_type+score so the console and evals can aggregate "why routes changed" during rollouts.

ashton: I'll run matcher sims with historical traces and include a column for extra matching passes and per-request latency delta.

lee: If perf delta >0.3ms p95 we should consider caching the second-pass results for the common prefixes.

deploy-bot: :rocket: [deploy] matcher-service v3.14.0 rolled to canary in us-west-2

sam: OK — next actions: I'll draft an RFC with DSL examples and console mockups; @ashton will run sims; @maria will draft telemetry events and UX notes. Ping me when drafts ready.

maria: Will do, adding sample traces and a support FAQ blurb.

ashton: ETA for sims EOD tomorrow.

lee: I'll look at caching options after sim results.

sam: Thanks team — marking this thread resolved for now, will re-open when RFC link posted.
